name: FUN_DOCIO_TRANSFORM_DOCUMENTS
description: This table contains details of logical documents and transformed documents for a given incoming document. Intelligent Document Recognition recognizes incoming documents and produces corresponding logical documents, which serve as units for transformation. Transformations are then applied to create the final transformed documents, which are subsequently sent to the target.

columns.name: TRANSFORM_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the transform document.

columns.name: INCOMING_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the unique Indicates the identifier of the incoming transformed document.

columns.name: OUTGOING_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the outgoing document.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Logical document ID for the transformed document.

columns.name: FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Flow code for the incoming document.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOCUMENT_PATH
columns.description: Indicates the object storage path of the logical document.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOCUMENT_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the logical document.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOCUMENT_FORMAT
columns.description: Indicates the format of the logical document.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOCUMENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Identifies transform document status code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_LGDOC_STATUS.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAILS
columns.description: Transformation error details of the logical document.

columns.name: FINGERPRINT_ID
columns.description: Fingerprint ID of the logical document.

columns.name: MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Indicates the transformation mapping identifier of the logical document.

columns.name: MAPPING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transformation mapping type for the logical document. IdentifiesTransformation mapping type code for the logical document. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_MAPPING_TYPES.

columns.name: TRANSFORMED_DOCUMENT_PATH
columns.description: Indicates the location of the transformed document.

columns.name: TRANSFORMED_DOCUMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the transformed document.

columns.name: TRANSFORMED_DOCUMENT_FORMAT
columns.description: Format of the transformed document.

columns.name: TOTAL_RECORDS
columns.description: Total records count in the transformed document.

columns.name: FAILED_RECORDS
columns.description: Failed records count in the transformed document.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
